turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided Owen gets a zero, and why did he find out on his phone?
I spoke with the vice principal before you came in.
The vice principal. So who else knows, and is anything on his record right now?
She's backing me completely. Policy is policy, and it isn't up to you.
Policy is policy. Then 4.2 says you call me before any mark goes in, and nobody did.
So frankly, this meeting is a courtesy.
A courtesy. Then answer me courteously: is anything on Owen's record, yes or no?
